# Flygon Flow API reference

Version 0.10.38 (2026-10-29) · 38 operations

Every operation is an HTTP call under the base URL of your Flow server:

```sh
curl -sS "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/$FLOW_ENV/cards" -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

Keys look like `flow_…` and carry a scope: `read` (list and get), `write` (create, update and move) or `admin` (keys, sharing and environments). The OpenAPI document is at `/api/v1/openapi.json`. Errors come back with an HTTP status plus a `code` and a `message`. Path parameters such as `{env}` are filled from the input. Any other input is sent as the query string for GET and DELETE, or as the JSON body otherwise.

## Environments

### `envs.list`

List environments

`GET /api/v1/envs` · scope `read` · MCP tool `envs_list`

Environments (workspaces) you own, newest first. Use an id from here as {env} in every other call.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].name` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].visibility` | enum | yes | One of `private`, `public`. |
| `items[].owner` | string |  |  |
| `items[].rev` | integer | yes |  |
| `items[].updatedAt` | string | null |  |  |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |

**Example: Your environments**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "default-workspace",
      "name": "Default workspace",
      "visibility": "private",
      "owner": "owner@example.test",
      "rev": 42,
      "updatedAt": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null
}
```

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}` · scope `read` · MCP tool `envs_get`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

**Output**

## MindMap charts

### `charts.list`

List charts

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts` · scope `read` · MCP tool `charts_list`

The org charts in an environment, with node and edge counts. `active` marks the chart open in the app.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].name` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].active` | boolean | yes |  |
| `items[].nodes` | integer | yes |  |
| `items[].edges` | integer | yes |  |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

**Example: Charts**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "c1",
      "name": "Flygon · brainstorm",
      "active": true,
      "nodes": 7,
      "edges": 7
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
}
```

### `nodes.create`

Create a node

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/nodes` · scope `write` · MCP tool `nodes_create`

Add a card to a chart. Without x/y it is placed at the origin, stepping 32px diagonally past occupied spots (as the app does).

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `chart` | string | yes | Chart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app. |
| `type` | enum | yes | One of `entity`, `person`, `area`, `note`. |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `notes` | string |  |  |
| `w` | number |  |  |
| `h` | number |  |  |
| `x` | number |  |  |
| `y` | number |  |  |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `node` | object | yes |  |
| `node.id` | string | yes |  |
| `node.name` | string | yes |  |
| `node.type` | enum | yes | One of `entity`, `person`, `area`, `note`. |
| `node.x` | number | yes |  |
| `node.y` | number | yes |  |
| `node.w` | number |  |  |
| `node.h` | number |  |  |
| `node.notes` | string |  |  |

**Example: Add a person**

```sh

  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
```

```json
    "y": 144,
    "notes": ""
  }
}
```

## Edges

### `edges.list`

List edges

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/edges` · scope `read` · MCP tool `edges_list`

Connections on a chart. Ownership edges carry a percent ("" when unspecified); group edges are grouping only.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `chart` | string | yes | Chart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app. |
| `node` | string |  | Only edges touching this node id. |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].from` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].to` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].type` | enum | yes | One of `ownership`, `group`. |
| `items[].percent` | string | yes |  |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

**Example: Edges**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/edges" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "o1",
      "from": "cleo",
      "to": "quill",
      "type": "ownership",
      "percent": "50"
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
}
```

### `edges.create`

Create an edge

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/edges` · scope `write` · MCP tool `edges_create`

Connect two cards on the same chart. A second edge between the same pair (same direction) is refused with 409.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `chart` | string | yes | Chart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app. |
| `from` | string | yes | Node id. |
| `to` | string | yes | Node id. |
| `type` | enum |  | One of `ownership`, `group`. |
| `percent` | string | number |  | 0-100, or "" for unspecified. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `edge` | object | yes |  |
| `edge.id` | string | yes |  |
| `edge.from` | string | yes |  |
| `edge.to` | string | yes |  |
| `edge.type` | enum | yes | One of `ownership`, `group`. |
| `edge.percent` | string | yes |  |

**Example: 50% ownership**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/edges" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"from":"cleo","to":"quill","percent":"50"}'
```

```json
{
  "rev": 45,
  "edge": {
    "id": "o1",
    "from": "cleo",
    "to": "quill",
    "type": "ownership",
    "percent": "50"
  }
}
```

### `edges.delete`

Delete an edge

`DELETE /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/edges/{edge}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `edges_delete`

Remove one connection. The cards it joined stay. Earlier revisions are kept in the workspace history.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `chart` | string | yes | Chart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app. |
| `edge` | string | yes | Edge id. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `deleted` | string | yes |  |

**Example: Delete**

```sh
curl -sS -X DELETE "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/edges/o1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "rev": 46,
  "deleted": "o1"
}
```

Create a project

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/projects` · scope `write` · MCP tool `projects_create`

| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |

| `items[].kind` | enum | yes | One of `feature`, `milestone`, `release`, `deadline`, `project`, `phase`, `event`. |

| `items[].start` | string | yes |  |

### `cards.list`

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/cards` · scope `read` · MCP tool `cards_list`

Board cards in board order. Filters: column, project (id, name or "none"), label (id or name), assignee (person id or name), agent (AgentFlow agent: cards delegated to it), q ("#12" or title text), hideDone.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `column` | string |  | Board column: requests (Requests / Sprinted), doing (Doing), blocked (Blocked), uat (UAT), done (Done), must (Backlog: Must Have), nice (Backlog: Nice to Have). One of `requests`, `doing`, `blocked`, `uat`, `done`, `must`, `nice`. |

| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |

| `items[].column` | string | yes |  |

| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

### `cards.move`

Move a DevOps card

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/cards/{card}/move` · scope `write` · MCP tool `cards_move`

Move a card to a column (and position: `index` among that column's other cards; end if left out). The board's gates apply: into Done needs `confirm: true`, or `approve: true` from UAT (the Approve button); out of Done needs `confirm: true`; into Doing without a developer needs `developer` (a person, who is assigned) or `confirm: true` to leave it unassigned. A refused gate is 409 with code confirm_done, confirm_reopen or pick_developer.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `card` | string | integer | yes | Card number or id. |
| `column` | string | yes | Board column: requests (Requests / Sprinted), doing (Doing), blocked (Blocked), uat (UAT), done (Done), must (Backlog: Must Have), nice (Backlog: Nice to Have). One of `requests`, `doing`, `blocked`, `uat`, `done`, `must`, `nice`. |
| `index` | integer |  |  |
| `confirm` | boolean |  |  |
| `approve` | boolean |  |  |
| `developer` | string |  | Person node id or name. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `card` | object | yes |  |
| `card.id` | string | yes |  |
| `card.number` | integer | yes |  |
| `card.title` | string | yes |  |
| `card.description` | string |  |  |
| `card.column` | string | yes |  |
| `card.project` | string |  |  |
| `card.labels` | string[] | yes |  |
| `card.points` | number | null |  |  |
| `card.due` | string |  |  |
| `card.assignees` | object[] | yes |  |
| `card.checklist` | object[] | yes |  |
| `card.links` | object[] | yes |  |
| `card.item` | string |  |  |
| `card.created` | string |  |  |

### `agents.work`

Get an agent's work queue

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents/{agent}/work` · scope `read` · MCP tool `agents_work`

What a runner needs to work as this agent: its `brief` and its queue, the open DevOps cards delegated to it (cards.update agents, or the card's Delegated to picker). Order: doing, requests, blocked, uat, must, nice (work in progress first; Blocked and UAT wait on others), then soonest due date, then #number. `columns` narrows the queue, e.g. ["doing","requests"] for cards it can act on now. Report back with cards.update (checklist, links) and cards.move.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `agent` | string | yes | Agent id or name. |
| `columns` | string[] |  | Only these columns (comma-separated in a query string). |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

### `agents.create`

Create an AgentFlow agent

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents` · scope `write` · MCP tool `agents_create`

Add an agent to the AgentFlow org chart. References (reportsTo, supervisor, projects, cards, items) are ids or names; unknown ones are refused with 400, and a reporting loop with reports_loop.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `name` | string | yes |  |

| `status` | enum |  | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`, `retired`. |
| `live` | boolean |  | The switch runners obey: false (the default) and runners leave the agent alone; true and the runner named in runtime works its queue. |

### `agents.delete`

Delete an AgentFlow agent

`DELETE /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents/{agent}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `agents_delete`

Remove an agent. Its direct reports move up to its manager, and workflow steps it ran become unassigned.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `agent` | string | yes | Agent id or name. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `deleted` | string | yes |  |

**Example: Remove the researcher**

```sh
curl -sS -X DELETE "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/agents/Researcher" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "rev": 58,
  "deleted": "a1"
}
```

### `runners.list`

List AgentFlow runners

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/runners` · scope `read` · MCP tool `runners_list`

Machines or services that run agents, with the models each one offers, as they last reported (runners.report). An agent's runtime names a runner and its model is one of that runner's model ids.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].name` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].models` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].reported` | string | yes |  |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

**Example: Runners**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/runners" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "name": "Home server",
      "models": [
        {
          "id": "claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5",
          "label": "Claude · Sonnet 5.5"
        }
      ],
      "reported": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
}
```

### `runners.report`

Report a runner and its models

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/runners/{runner}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `runners_report`

A runner says what it can run. The model list replaces the old one; nothing is saved when it has not changed, so a runner may report on every pass. Agents name the runner in runtime and pick a model id. Up to 20 runners and 500 models each.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `runner` | string | yes | Runner name, e.g. Home server. |
| `models` | object[] | yes |  |
| `models[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `models[].label` | string |  |  |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `runner` | object | yes |  |
| `runner.name` | string | yes |  |
| `runner.models` | object[] | yes |  |
| `runner.reported` | string | yes |  |
| `changed` | boolean | yes |  |

**Example: Home server**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/runners/Home%20server" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"models":[{"id":"claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5","label":"Claude · Sonnet 5.5"}]}'
```

```json
{
  "rev": 59,
  "runner": {
    "name": "Home server",
    "models": [
      {
        "id": "claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5",
        "label": "Claude · Sonnet 5.5"
      }
    ],
    "reported": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
  },
  "changed": true
}
```

## AgentFlow workflows

### `workflows.list`

List AgentFlow workflows

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/workflows` · scope `read` · MCP tool `workflows_list`

Workflows: ordered steps, each handled by an agent, started by hand, on a schedule or by an event. Filters: status, agent (id or name: workflows with a step it runs), project and q.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `status` | enum |  | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`. |
| `agent` | string |  | Agent id or name. |
| `project` | string |  | Project id or name. |
| `q` | string |  |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].name` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].description` | string |  |  |
| `items[].status` | enum | yes | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`. |
| `items[].trigger` | enum | yes | One of `manual`, `schedule`, `event`. |
| `items[].schedule` | string |  |  |
| `items[].steps` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].projects` | string[] | yes |  |
| `items[].cards` | string[] | yes |  |
| `items[].items` | string[] | yes |  |
| `items[].created` | string |  |  |
| `items[].updated` | string |  |  |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

### `workflows.create`

Create an AgentFlow workflow

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/workflows` · scope `write` · MCP tool `workflows_create`

Add a workflow. Each step names an agent (id or name, or "" for unassigned), what it does and what it produces. Links (projects, cards, items) are ids or names.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `description` | string |  |  |
| `status` | enum |  | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`. |
| `trigger` | enum |  | manual, schedule or event. One of `manual`, `schedule`, `event`. |
| `schedule` | string |  | When or on what it starts, e.g. "Weekdays at 09:00". |
| `steps` | object[] |  |  |
| `steps[].id` | string |  |  |
| `steps[].agent` | string |  | Agent id or name; "" for unassigned. |
| `steps[].action` | string |  |  |
| `steps[].output` | string |  |  |
| `projects` | string[] |  |  |
| `cards` | string | integer[] |  |  |
| `items` | string[] |  |  |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `workflow` | object | yes |  |
| `workflow.id` | string | yes |  |
| `workflow.name` | string | yes |  |
| `workflow.description` | string |  |  |
| `workflow.status` | enum | yes | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`. |
| `workflow.trigger` | enum | yes | One of `manual`, `schedule`, `event`. |
| `workflow.schedule` | string |  |  |
| `workflow.steps` | object[] | yes |  |
| `workflow.projects` | string[] | yes |  |
| `workflow.cards` | string[] | yes |  |

| `workflow.created` | string |  |  |
| `workflow.updated` | string |  |  |

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/workflows" \
```

## Search

### `search`

Search an environment

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/search` · scope `read` · MCP tool `search`

Case-insensitive search over chart nodes (name, notes), projects, timeline items (title, notes), cards (#number, title, description), AgentFlow agents (name, role, purpose) and workflows (name, description). `types` narrows it (comma-separated in a query string).

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `q` | string | yes |  |
| `types` | enum[] |  |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].type` | enum | yes | One of `node`, `project`, `item`, `card`, `agent`, `workflow`. |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].title` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].chart` | string |  |  |
| `items[].number` | integer |  |  |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

**Example: Sign-up**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/search?q=sign-up" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "type": "card",
      "id": "k1",
      "title": "Build sign-up form",
      "number": 12
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
}
```
